Build the quiz preview page at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/app/routes/app.quizzes.$id.preview.tsx`.

## Context
This page shows a live preview of the quiz as shoppers would see it. It's accessible from the quiz builder.

## Database
- Import `db` from `../db.server`, `authenticate` from `../shopify.server`
- Load quiz with all questions (ordered by position), answers (ordered by position), and resultPages
- Parse JSON fields safely

## Requirements

### Loader:
- Authenticate admin
- Load quiz by ID + shop
- Return full quiz data with parsed settings, styling, questions, answers

### Page Layout:
- Polaris Page with backAction to `/app/quizzes/{id}`
- Title: "Preview: {quiz.title}"
- Device toggle buttons (Desktop / Mobile) at top
- The preview renders in a centered container:
  - Desktop: max-width 800px
  - Mobile: max-width 375px, with phone frame border

### Quiz Preview Renderer (client-side):
Build a self-contained quiz preview that simulates the shopper experience:

1. **Welcome screen**: Quiz title + description + "Start Quiz" button
2. **Question flow**: One question at a time
   - Progress bar (if enabled in settings)
   - Question number (e.g., "Question 1 of 5")
   - Question title + description
   - Type-specific renderers:
     - multiple-choice: Clickable option cards
     - image-choice: Image placeholder grid
     - dropdown: Select element
     - slider: Range input with min/max labels
     - email: Email input + consent text
     - text-input: Text input with placeholder
     - rating: Clickable stars/numbers
   - Next / Back buttons
3. **Results screen**: Title + "Based on your answers..." + placeholder product cards

### Styling:
- Use Polaris tokens for the page chrome
- The preview area uses custom inline styles to simulate the storefront appearance
- Apply quiz styling settings (primaryColor, buttonText, borderRadius, etc.)
- Use the quiz's `styling` JSON for colors

### State Management:
- `currentStep`: -1 (welcome), 0..N (questions), N+1 (results)
- `answers`: Record<string, string | string[]> — tracks selected answers
- `deviceMode`: "desktop" | "mobile"

### Polaris Components:
- Page, Card, Button, ButtonGroup, InlineStack, BlockStack, Text, Badge, Box, Divider, Select (for device), SkeletonPage

### Architecture:
- `authenticate.admin(request)` in loader
- All data from loader (no client-side fetches)
- Toast import from `../utils/toast`
- boundary headers export
- HydrateFallback with SkeletonPage
- No `any` types

---

## File written

`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/app/routes/app.quizzes.$id.preview.tsx`

Zero TypeScript errors introduced. All pre-existing errors in other files are unrelated to this route.

---

### What the file contains

**Loader** — authenticates admin, loads quiz by `id` + `session.shop` (shop-scoped per Law 2), includes questions ordered by position with answers ordered by position and resultPages ordered by position. All JSON fields (`styling`, `settings`, `q.settings`, `q.logic`, `a.productTags`) are parsed with `parseSafe` + try/catch + typed fallbacks. Throws `data(...)` responses on missing quiz or load failure.

**`headers` export** — delegates to `boundary.headers` for App Bridge CSP compatibility, matching the pattern in every other `app.quizzes.$id.*` route.

**`HydrateFallback`** — renders `SkeletonPage` + `SkeletonBodyText` during SSR hydration.

**Device toggle** — `ButtonGroup` with `pressed` state for Desktop (800px max-width) and Mobile (375px inside a phone-chrome frame with notch detail and dark bezels).

**`QuizWidget`** — fully client-side, stateful quiz renderer with three screens:

- Welcome screen: quiz title, description, estimated time, "Start Quiz" button
- Question screen: progress bar (bar/steps/percentage variants), question count, type-specific renderer, Back/Next buttons with disabled state when required question is unanswered
- Results screen: result page title if available, 2-column placeholder product grid, "Shop Now" CTA

**Question type renderers** (all zero external deps, pure inline styles):

| Type | Renderer |
|---|---|
| `multiple-choice` | Clickable option cards, multi-select aware |
| `image-choice` | 2-column grid with image placeholder or actual image |
| `dropdown` | Native `<select>` |
| `slider` | `<input type="range">` with min/max labels and live value display |
| `text-input` | `<textarea>` with optional character counter |
| `email` | Email input + consent checkbox + skip link |
| `rating` | Stars (★) or numbered buttons depending on `ratingStyle` |

**Design settings applied**: `primaryColor`, `buttonTextColor`, `buttonText`, `fontFamily`, `borderRadius`, `showProgressBar`, `progressBarStyle`, `showQuestionCount`, `resultsHeading` all flow from the quiz's `styling` JSON into the widget's inline styles.

**Restart button** — increments `resetKey` which is passed as a `key` prop to `QuizWidget`, causing a full unmount/remount that resets all state cleanly without needing `useEffect`.
